notes: Count: the district's board history names 34 people; the archive's sources add Don Allen (trustee 1973-1975, omitted by the district). Total 35. Nathan's figure of 'forty' is not reached; the board history's gaps (1970, 1979, and the four-name years 1974-1975, 1982-1984, 1984-1985) could hide others, and no source read names any.

Student trustees: the district's board history lists none, and none is treated here as a voting member. Don Benton was a student trustee before his elected terms (Boyer); Ryan Joslin was student trustee in 2013 (co1310a).
Terms before 1995 rest on the board history's yearly lists, which say who sat, not how they came or left; where no other source speaks, the term says 'not found'.
Wikipedia was not used as a source. The only Wikipedia-matching fact is Wilk's appointment date of August 23, 2006, which #335 states without a source: an unsourced lead.

disputed.name: Adrian Adams (Judge Adrian W. Adams)
disputed.claim: Leon Worden's caption to AA7401 calls him 'Trustee Adrian Adams' at the April 22, 1974 IRC dedication, and #28667's research note repeats it.
disputed.against: The Canyon Call of April 15, 1974 names him at that ceremony only as 'Judge Adrian Adams of the Newhall Municipal Court', giving the tribute to Bonelli; Boyer, a trustee present, lists the governing board then as Muhl, Huntsinger, Claffey, Don Allen and himself; the district's board history never lists Adams; and Adams's own 1981 note to Boyer speaks of 'my days on a school board' (he was on the Hart board, 1957-1963, holding #28751).
disputed.conclusion: Not a college trustee on the evidence read; not counted among the trustees. The same caption calls Fortine a trustee in April 1974, which Boyer and the board history also contradict. Nathan to decide whether to correct the caption on the photograph record when it is imported.

contest1973.summary: The research file's single '1973' contest was two elections. The return of neither was found.

spring1973.date: 1973, spring (reported in The Canyon Call of May 1, 1973 as "recent school district elections"; exact date not found)
spring1973.seats: the two terms expiring in 1973, held by Bruce Fortine and John Hackney (The Signal, June 23, 1972)
spring1973.result: Bruce Fortine re-elected to a four-year term; Don Allen, a COC student, elected (to the seat Hackney had held, inferred)

november1973.result: Carl Boyer elected, "defeated six candidates, receiving 2,646 of slightly more than 9,000 ballots"
november1973.seat: not stated; Fortine left the board between May 1973 and April 1974 (not a member at the April 1974 dedication per Boyer; COC director of community services by late 1974), so a contest for his seat is a likely reading, not a read fact
november1973.otherCandidates: six, not named in the OCR read

contest1973.boardHistory: The district's board history lists Fortine and Hackney in 1973 and, for 1974-1975, only Claffey, Muhl, Boyer and Huntsinger: it omits Don Allen entirely.
contest1973.searched: Mirror /Volumes/Reggie/SCVHistory/scvhistory.com, Python cp1252 over every .htm/.html/.txt, 5 October 2026, for each trustee name and 'COC|College of the Canyons|college' + 'board|trustee'; the Canyon Call OCR volumes 1971-1979 read for 'trustee', 'election', 'resign', candidates' names; Boyer's 2015 book (all chapter PDFs via pdftotext). No Signal report of either 1973 return is on the mirror.

otherContestsFound.note: Boyer (2015, ch.2) gives the special election's count: 1,949 voters; Claffey 398, Don Allen 327, Larry Wade 305, Carl Boyer 297, Ken Wullschleger 248, the others 86 or less (eleven candidates). Election record #29910 has only Claffey and Allen and no count; Boyer was himself a losing candidate.

Three full terms and Don Allen's unexpired term; 13 candidates. Elected (inferred from the 1976 board and Boyer): Claffey, Huntsinger, Reiter (full terms); Rentz (unexpired). Muhl, an incumbent, not returned. Return not found. No election record exists.
Boyer re-elected (majority against five opponents); Kevin Lynch elected. Return not found. No election record exists.
William Broyles elected (Boyer). Return not found.

Office No. 1: Don Benton 2,000, Carl Boyer (inc.) 1,788. Office No. 3: Linda Cubbage 1,985, Kevin Lynch (inc.) 1,865. 4,136 ballots. (Boyer, 2015; a trustee's retrospective account, not the canvass.) No election record exists.
